data.body: AC amendment: Migrator must handle configs that already contain dso.workflow= key (written by /dso:onboarding on new projects). Detection: _canonical=$(grep -m1 '^dso\.workflow=' "$CONFIG" 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2-). If _canonical is non-empty: skip legacy key mapping and config rewrite entirely; just create the sentinel file and exit 0. Without this, a config written by onboarding (dso.workflow=ci-pr, no legacy keys) would have the migrator incorrectly map empty legacy keys to 'local' and overwrite the correct value. Add test coverage to test function test_migrator_skips_rewrite_when_dso_workflow_already_present in task c7ca-d55e-d1e0-4774 (or add as test 13 in the RED test file).
